title: Industrial Refinery

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Turns ores into nice refined materials.

body:
"The best refinery you can obtain! Turn ores into nice refined material."

Description

The Industrial Refinery is the last obtainable tier of refineries. It can be found and purchased at The Oak Depot. It is used to smelt raw ores/rocks into refined ores/rocks by putting them through its conveyor.

The description says: The best refinery you can obtain! Turn ores into nice, refined material.

Appearance

A large refinery.

Trivia

  • This is the largest and most expensive refinery in-game.
  • If an object blocking the output, it will not produce (same with forgers and plankers).
    • During blockage it will save entered materials (the amount of them is shown in stat info menu), after removing blockage it will produce all queued materials from first entered to last entered.
